# Pixelette Certified: full page directory

> UK-headquartered cyber security, compliance, assurance and AI governance consultancy, focused principally on the United Kingdom, the United States and the GCC. Office: 66 Paul Street, London, EC2A 4NA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com.

Pixelette Certified is a consultancy. It is not a certification body and does not issue certificates, SOC 2 reports or scheme certifications; those are issued by independent certification bodies, licensed CPA firms and authorised Certification Bodies respectively. Practitioner credentials are held by individuals within its specialist delivery network, not by the company. See /llms.txt for the summary version.
